fusions.name: Venom Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a dart that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellowing Report
fusions.desc: Lets off a booming report in a cone ahead of you, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Recoil Spring
fusions.desc: Fires into the ground and springs you 4 tiles forward, then you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Pond
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
